label: Computer tools
description: Describe a computer's actions to a model: the tool declarations to wire into an LLM node's `tools`. Each copies a vendor's own computer tool, its name and its fields, so the model calls it the way it was trained to, through any provider: `anthropic` declares Anthropic's (left_click, key, zoom, ...), `openai` declares OpenAI's (click, keypress, ...); both add `bash` for the shell. RouteComputerCall reads a call in either style. Coordinates are pixels of the last full screenshot, which the Computer takes at the screen's own size. A screenshot tool is always declared; each other action has a switch, all on by default.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Style
inputs.description: Whose tool names to declare. Claude models know Anthropic's, GPT models OpenAI's; any other model takes either.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.label: Zoom
inputs.description: Enlarge a region of the screen. Anthropic's style only.

inputs.name: click
inputs.label: Click
inputs.description: Click and double-click (and right, middle and triple click in Anthropic's style).

inputs.name: drag
inputs.label: Drag
inputs.description: Drag from one point to another.

inputs.name: mouseButtons
inputs.label: Mouse down and up
inputs.description: Press and release the left button as separate steps. Anthropic's style only.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.label: Cursor position
inputs.description: Ask where the mouse is. Anthropic's style only.

inputs.name: keys
inputs.label: Keys
inputs.description: Press keys and combinations (and hold them, in Anthropic's style).

inputs.name: wait
inputs.label: Wait
inputs.description: Wait for the screen to settle.

inputs.name: terminal
inputs.label: Shell
inputs.description: Run commands in the computer's shell, as bash.

outputs.name: tools
outputs.description: The declarations, for an LLM node's `tools`.
